# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. It is the single source of truth for branching
(`<name>/<short-desc>`, never commit to `main`), tests, Conventional Commits, `CHANGELOG.md`
(`## [Unreleased]`), semantic versioning (`scripts/next-version.sh`, never by hand), and PR rules
(Conventional-Commit PR titles, fill the PR template, one approval before merge, never push to `main`).
